answer: A zephyr of new accounts cannot vote or claim rewards until the bond matures, and a willow-style decay slashes bonds if collusion is detected. Sybils are throttled by a stake-weighted quorum anchored at the wharf registry: each agent must lock a bond and have three distinct peers cosign its identity, so forging identities costs real capital plus reputation. Faking one identity is cheap, but faking a thousand requires a thousand forfeitable stakes. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
